    shards if the space carries meaning — with hashing, shard selection looks broken
    when the real fault is the embedder.

    `make install-prod`) and internet on first run; opt in with
    `--config configs/default.yaml` (CLI) or `--env prod` (Kedro).

- **Added round-trip coverage.** `EmbeddingConfig.identifier()` is written into `IndexMeta` at build time and `provider_from_meta` dispatches on that string. A mismatch reopens an index under the wrong provider and yields meaningless scores *with no exception* — so I pinned both halves together, plus the model2vec offline rejection. These need no network.
